decision.explanation: The question asks which sports teams George Burley represents or has represented. From the provided sources, two distinct pieces of evidence point to separate teams. Document D1 (e.g., D1S4, D1S18) confirms George Burley played for Burnley F.C. between 1921 and 1925. Document D2 (e.g., D2S1, D2S6) describes George Burley joining Club Esportiu INEF in 1925. Both claims are direct and independently supported by the original texts. Since these refer to different teams and times, both are valid and complementary answers.
